_meta.title: Compatibility long-form write-ups (Co-Star style)
_meta.model: function + your_line + their_line/same_sign_line + verdict; Moon and Venus are source-only authored compatibility libraries
_meta.note: Sign trait clauses condensed from Marie Satori, 'As Above, So Below' (2023) — her verbatim per-sign Moon/Mercury/Venus descriptions — plus cc-planet-in-sign-reviewed. Voiced-original condensations of her words; tier voiced-original-grounded, DRAFT pending sign-off. NOT served as verbatim Marie.

aries.function: The Sun is your essential self, your identity and the spirit you lead with. It shows how each of you shines and takes up space.
aries.your_line: You both have Sun in Aries, meaning your identity comes through bold and direct: you'd rather start something than wait to be asked, though you can act before you think and charge in on impulse.
aries.same_sign_line: You share the same core identity, so you recognize each other fast. You lead the same way and shine in the same kind of room, and you understand what drives the other without it being explained. The catch is that you also share the same blind spot, and neither of you brings an outside angle to it. Let each of you lead where you are genuinely strongest instead of competing for the same attention.
aries.verdict: You're cut from the same cloth, and the respect is real.
aries.synthesis: You can compete for the same spotlight instead of sharing it. Root for each other; there's room for two to shine.
aries.tier: descriptions = REVIEWED authored voice (natal_sign_story); their_line pronoun-shifted; synthesis/match voiced-original

taurus.function: The Sun is your essential self, your identity and the spirit you lead with. It shows how each of you shines and takes up space.
taurus.your_line: Your Sun is in Aries, meaning your identity comes through bold and direct: you'd rather start something than wait to be asked, though you can act before you think and charge in on impulse.
taurus.their_line: Their Sun is in Taurus, meaning they know who they are slowly and solidly, and they don't move until it feels worth it, though they can dig in and resist change until it costs they progress.
taurus.verdict: Your cores don't quite line up, but you can stretch each other.
taurus.synthesis: Your pace and priorities can fall out of step. Check what matters most to each of you this season.
taurus.tier: descriptions = REVIEWED authored voice (natal_sign_story); their_line pronoun-shifted; synthesis/match voiced-original

Your Moon is in Cancer, meaning you feel things deeply and keep them protected, and home is less a place to you than the feeling of being safe with your people. This is learned behavior. If care in your house growing up came on strong, or came and went, you learned to hold your people close and to look after everyone as a way of belonging. You still need to feel safe before you can be honest, because tone reaches you before words do. When you're upset, you pull in without announcing it, take care of everyone anyway, and wait to see who notices.

Their Moon is in Aquarius, meaning they think their way through their emotions, and space is how they process. This is learned behavior. If the people around them growing up kept their feelings contained, they learned to handle yours the same way, working them out privately instead of showing them, and needing nobody became a point of pride. They still need freedom to come to things in their own time, because pressure to feel on cue empties them out. When they're upset, they go analytical and distant, and they can describe the feeling perfectly to everyone except the person it's about.

Your Moon in Cancer and {friend}'s Moon in Aquarius are water and air, so you move toward where {friend} moves back. You can get {friend} to admit a feeling now and then, and {friend} can give you enough distance to see the whole picture. But watch the loop when it goes wrong: the more you reach in, the further {friend} pulls away, and the quieter {friend} goes, the closer you move, so {friend} feels you at the door too soon. You aren't trying to smother {friend}, and {friend} isn't rejecting you. You're both doing the thing that used to work.

You still need to get to the bottom of things, because half-truths bother you more than bad news does. When you're not sure where you stand with someone, you start watching them closely, testing them, and keeping tabs instead of asking.

They still need stimulation, because boredom weighs on them more than most problems do. When they're upset, they get chatty and clever instead of sad, and they can explain a feeling ten ways before they actually feel it once.

If you grew up around someone whose mood could change the whole day, you learned to notice the small signs early, and reading people before trusting them became how you stayed safe. You still need to get to the bottom of things, because half-truths bother you more than bad news does. When you're not sure where you stand with someone, you start watching them closely, testing them, and keeping tabs instead of asking.
aquarius.their_line: Their Moon is in Aquarius, meaning they think their way through their emotions, and space is how they process. This is learned behavior. If the people around them growing up kept their feelings contained, they learned to handle yours the same way, working them out privately instead of showing them, and needing nobody became a point of pride. They still need freedom to come to things in their own time, because pressure to feel on cue empties them out. When they're upset, they go analytical and distant, and they can describe the feeling perfectly to everyone except the person it's about.
aquarius.verdict: Your Moon in Scorpio and {friend}'s Moon in Aquarius are water and air, both fixed, so you want depth right where {friend} wants distance. You're both fascinated by what the other is, and you keep circling back to figure each other out. But watch the loop when you're hurt: the more you go all the way in, the more {friend} detaches, and the more {friend} detaches, the harder you press for depth, until you lock horns and neither gives. You aren't trying to corner {friend}, and {friend} isn't refusing to feel. You're both doing the thing that used to work.

aries.your_line: Your Moon is in Sagittarius, meaning you feel better the moment you get out, and a bad mood with nowhere to go turns into a cage fast. This is learned behavior. If the people around you growing up were free spirits, or if home felt small, you learned that leaving worked, and that a joke, a trip, or a bigger perspective could beat sitting in the feeling. You still need something to look forward to, because a life with nothing on the horizon starts to feel like a dead end. When you're upset, or when someone leans on you too hard, you make it funny, make it a story, or make plans, anything but admit it.

If they grew up around someone quick to flare, anger was probably the feeling that got results, so they learned to stand up for themselves right away instead of waiting to see how bad it would get. They still need wins, because sitting still with a problem feels worse to them than picking the wrong fight. When they're upset, they react first and deal with the damage later.

virgo.same_sign_line: You carry the same lesson, so you take each other's responsibilities seriously and understand each other's fears without explanation. virgo.verdict: You carry the same weight, and you can carry it together.
virgo.synthesis: You can reinforce the same fear or limit instead of easing it. Be the one who reminds the other it's allowed to be enough.

aquarius.verdict: Your discipline works differently, but if you learn to work together you carry more than either could alone.
aquarius.synthesis: Your timelines and standards can grind against each other. Define what 'done' and 'enough' mean to each of you.

pisces.function: Saturn rules structure, discipline, and limits. It shows how each of you handles responsibility and the long game.
pisces.your_line: You both have Saturn in Pisces, meaning your work is around faith and boundaries: giving form to the formless, though you can avoid the boundary and let responsibility dissolve.
pisces.same_sign_line: You carry the same lesson, so you take each other's responsibilities seriously and understand each other's fears without explanation. The risk is reinforcing the same limit or fear instead of easing it, and getting heavy together. Be the one who reminds the other it is allowed to be enough, and do not let discipline become a contest over who has it harder.
pisces.verdict: You carry the same weight, and you can carry it together.
pisces.synthesis: You can reinforce the same fear or limit instead of easing it. Be the one who reminds the other it's allowed to be enough.
